messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}, thanks so
much for being my friend.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It's meant a lot to me.
{07 00 00}I know this is sudden,{01 00 00 0a 00} but
I've decided to move away.
Don't try to stop me.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}, aitäh
sulle sõpruse eest.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See tähendas mulle palju.
{07 00 00}Tean, et see tuleb äkki,{01 00 00 0a 00} aga
olen otsustanud ära kolida.
Ära püüa mind takistada.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Um,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00} I'm moving
away. There. I said it.

{07 16 00}I couldn't bear to see you
cry,{01 00 00 0a 00} so I've been keeping it
secret from you until now.
{07 14 00}But the time has come to
say farewell,{01 00 00 0a 00} so thanks for
everything,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ee,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00} ma kolin
ära. Nii. Ütlesin ära.

{07 16 00}Ei kannatanud näha, kuidas
sa nutad,{01 00 00 0a 00} nii et hoidsin
seda seni saladuses.
{07 14 00}Aga aeg on hüvasti jätta,{01 00 00 0a 00}
nii et aitäh kõige eest,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} I've
decided it's time for me to
leave this town behind.
{07 16 00}I enjoyed my time here. {01 01 00}{07 15 00}But
I have no choice. There's
better food elsewhere{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} olen
otsustanud, et on aeg see
linn selja taha jätta.
{07 16 00}Mul oli siin tore. {01 01 00}{07 15 00}Aga
mul pole valikut. Mujal on
parem söök{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Huh huh huh.{01 00 00 0a 00} I hope you'll
think of me once in a
while,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.

{07 16 00}You can't do this.{01 00 00 0a 00} Trying
to stop me isn't like you!

{07 14 00}I need you to laugh and
smile as you see me off,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Sa ei saa seda teha.{01 00 00 0a 00} Minu
takistamine pole sinu moodi!

{07 14 00}Tahan, et sa naerad ja
naeratad, kui mind saadad,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Ohh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}when you say those
things to me, it makes my
heart ache.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ohh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}kui sa mulle
nii ütled, teeb see
südame haigeks.

messages.en:
{07 06 00}No! I can't have this!{01 00 00 0a 00} I'm a
man, for goodness' sake!

{07 15 00}Once I've made up my mind,
there's no changing it,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Ei! Nii ei lähe!{01 00 00 0a 00} Ma olen
mees, jumala pärast!

{07 15 00}Kui olen otsuse teinud,
siis seda ei muuda,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Wow. I wasn't expecting that
response{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. {07 00 00}Maybe I'll think
it over once more.
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Vau. Ma ei oodanud sellist
vastust{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. {07 00 00}Ehk mõtlen
asja veel korra läbi.

messages.en:
{07 02 00}Why would you say that?{01 01 00}
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Are you trying to tell me
something?
{07 0a 00}Huh huh huh!{01 00 00 0a 00} Maybe I'll
stick around a little bit
longer,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Miks sa nii ütled?{01 01 00}
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Kas sa tahad mulle midagi
öelda?
{07 0a 00}Hah hah haa!{01 00 00 0a 00} Äkki jäängi
veel natukeseks ajaks
siia,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Well, this is a problem.
I didn't expect you to
respond like that{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}I guess maybe I should stay
in this town, huh?{02 00 00 10 11}
Don't leave me!
Maybe?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Noh, see on probleem.
Ma ei oodanud, et sa
nii vastad{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}Vist peaksin siia linna
ikkagi jääma, mis?{02 00 00 10 11}
Ära jäta mind!
Ehk?

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Yeah{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00} Somehow I get the
feeling{01 00 00 0a 00} that if I move,
something bad will happen!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Jah{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00} Millegipärast on
mul tunne,{01 00 00 0a 00} et kui ma kolin,
juhtub midagi halba!
